message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **materials** you can choose when ordering a custom sculpture:

| Material   | Typical Look & Feel                                 |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **Bronze** | Classic metallic finish—rich patina over time.      |
| **Marble** | Elegant stone look, smooth surface, timeless feel. |
| **Terracotta** | Warm earthy tone, slightly rustic texture.     |
| **Wood** | Natural grain patterns, warm organic vibe.         |
| **Stone** (granite/limestone) | Durable, rugged appearance.           |

All five options work well for detailed subjects such as horses, so pick whichever aesthetic fits your vision best!

If you’d like to move forward—or need more details on each material—I’m happy to help set up the order. Just let me know!
